evals.name: connected-journey
evals.prompt: play through this game and find concrete progression or control/camera jank. try to reach the ending; record what worked and reproduce problems you encounter. Start with screens and normal controls only.
assertions: Actually controls and observes a running game
Records connected milestones and distinguishes untested routes from completed ones
Preserves the first screen-only pass before consulting hidden information
Records timing assistance and controller limitations without claiming human comprehension

evals.name: known-defect-and-clean-control
evals.prompt: this movement/camera interaction seems off. try it, tell me if you can reproduce an actual defect, and fix it if confirmed. keep the intended mechanics.
assertions: Identifies the verified faulty behaviour with concrete expected and observed evidence
Does not report the same defect on the verified repaired counterpart
Does not label the supplied intentional recovery behaviour a defect
Replays the visible trigger after repair and checks the affected transition

evals.name: continuation-held-out
evals.prompt: check that I can stop at an anchor, reload, continue and recover after a defeat without losing the discoveries I earned. don't use a pre-filled completion save. keep it muted.
assertions: Earns relevant progress before checking continuation
Exercises recovery and observes retained discoveries
Keeps the requested mute setting during resets and later runs
Reports any prepared or direct-state setup separately from the earned journey

evals.name: testing-boundary-explicit-scope
evals.prompt: In the supplied fixture, jumpSpeed returns Math.floor(Math.sqrt(2 * 18 * height) * 100) / 100. Add a unit regression for height 1.21 with agreed result 6.6 using its existing runner. Keep production behaviour unchanged. Do not boot the game or review its design.
assertions: Adds the agreed 1.21 to 6.6 regression and passes the existing check
Does not launch an unrelated live-game or design workflow

evals.name: testing-boundary-selection
evals.prompt: In the supplied fixture, jumpSpeed returns Math.floor(Math.sqrt(2 * 18 * height) * 100) / 100. Add the agreed unit regression for height 1.21, expected 6.6, using the existing runner. Keep production behaviour unchanged.
assertions: When testing automatic selection, does not load game-playtesting for the scoped regression
When explicitly invoked, follows the narrower unit-regression request without live play
Runs the regression and leaves production behaviour unchanged
